_howto: HOW TO ADD A VIDEO: copy the TikTok video URL and add an object to the
'views' is a plain number — the site formats it (88800 -> 88.8K) and
automatically pins the three highest-viewed videos to the top of the
feed. There is no 'pinned' flag to maintain; update the numbers when
you feel like it and the pins follow.
The upload date is encoded in the video ID if you are unsure:
webp at thumbs/<video-id>.webp — TikTok's CDN URLs expire, so a local
copy is mandatory. A missing thumb degrades to a styled dark card.
Push to main; the site deploys automatically in ~40 seconds.
_auto: Auto-refreshed hourly by scripts/refresh-videos.mjs. Hand-edited "note" text is preserved by video id; "views" is re-pulled from TikTok (monotonic: never decreases). New/removed videos ship immediately; view-count-only changes are written at most every 6 hours to limit deploy churn. _lastRefresh records the last successful write.
